levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: Three taḥwīl routes. The first and second reach هشام through the «جميعا عن هشام» convergence (rule 3), so هشام is written in both; the third writes its own Hisham. «- واللفظ له -» is a gloss: left out. «الحارث بن هشام، سأل النبي» is inside Aisha's story: scene only (rule 5).
